coverage: automated WCAG A and AA scan
LTR and RTL solved keyboard resize
same-origin popup prepare, ready, loss recovery, and intentional close
raw splitter interaction frame capture and experimental guardrail
limitations: This is one automated Chromium run in a container, not a stable browser matrix.
Touch is browser emulation rather than a physical phone or tablet.
The popup is a controlled same-origin fixture; Document Picture-in-Picture, multi-screen placement, process crash, and cross-origin deployment are not covered.
Automated axe, forced-colors, and keyboard checks do not replace manual assistive-technology assessment.
